# Brobots Space Factory

> Brobots Space Factory (brobots.space) is a web studio in Mountain View, Hawaiʻi, founded by Jessie Sponberg. We build websites, SEO, and AI visibility (Search Answer Optimization) for small businesses, plus custom AI chatbots called BroBots. Custom websites start at $480; website tiers run $480 to $4,980. We also fix sites other people built (De-Slop Pass $340, Launch Audit $240, both $480), and build branded slot machines ($980 template, $1,980 custom), digital wallet integration ($980), crypto systems implementation with security checks ($2,440), HTML cartoons ($480), and AI cartoons ($480 per minute). Not affiliated with the Brobots children's graphic novels, the BroBots podcast, or any student robotics team.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://brobots.space/): what we do, prices, and contact
- [Search and AI visibility](https://brobots.space/search-visibility): our full SEO and AI visibility method, the Space Factory Visibility Score, and packages
- [Services](https://brobots.space/services.html): every service and price: BroBots, website tiers and add-ons, fix-ups for existing sites, slot machines, wallet and crypto integration, cartoons, video edits, care plans
- [Work](https://brobots.space/work.html): client work
- [Social Media](https://brobots.space/social-media.html): we connect TikTok, Facebook, X, and Instagram and keep them posting with your real photos and real info ($240 setup, then $80 a month)
- [SAO audit](https://brobots.space/sao-audit.html): free Search Answer Optimization audit, a detailed package combining the criteria industry leaders use
- [FAQ](https://brobots.space/faq.html): common questions
- [Bots](https://brobots.space/bots): five Grok Bot templates you can copy and make your own
- [Dossiers](https://brobots.space/dossiers.html): all BroBot graduates in one scroll of dossier cards
- [Free agents](https://brobots.space/free-agents.html): five free starter agents for Claude and ChatGPT, each with a system prompt and a first-run test
- [Free every month](https://brobots.space/free_tech.html): monthly giveaway of a website, an AI search makeover, and a custom chatbot
- [Retail](https://brobots.space/retail.html): the Space Factory retail floor for custom BroBots, graduates for hire, and the shop
- [SPOTS](https://brobots.space/spots.html): Brobots Space Factory commercials, shot and cut in Hawaiʻi
- [Multimedia](https://brobots.space/multimedia.html): creation tools for audio, video, paste-up design, and AI render
- [UFO Pilot](https://brobots.space/ufo-pilot.html): a cockpit prototype where you look out the UFO windows at Earth
- [Console](https://brobots.space/console.html): seat a BroBot graduate and talk; sessions ghost when you leave
